'''Muglund''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] member of the [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3642 BBY]] he and [[Reneget Vause]] were confronted by a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. Vause refused to fight an "unworthy" opponent and left, leaving Muglund alone. After being defeated, Muglund begged for his life, offering to tell Hunter Vauses's location if the Hunter let him go.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Muglund appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Bounty Hunter class mission on Hoth.
